CookiesPreferences.header: I use cookies to make this website work smoothly and improve your experience.
CookiesPreferences.technicalCookies: Technical Cookies: are essential for the website to function properly and cannot be turned off. They remember things like your language preference and cookie consent choice. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.
CookiesPreferences.functionalCookies: Functional Cookies: help provide extra features and personalisation, for example through the AI-powered chatbot. If you choose not to allow these cookies, some parts of the site may not work as intended.
